params.caption: 🎮 Paradox Interactive changes CEO again as Fredrik Wester steps down Fredrik Wester is leaving the CEO job at Paradox Interactive, the publisher behind Stellaris, Crusader Kings and Cities: Skylines, for the second time. Deputy CEO Mattias Lilja will take over in January. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 22:52 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👍 Good move or bad sign?
